# Young potatoes

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-potato-plant-1.md" title="Young potatoes"><img src="icons/34.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Young potatoes"></a>

Young potatoes are stage 2 of the potato crop. Harvesting early returns **one potato** for eating or replanting; wait until ripe for **2–4 potatoes**.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | World block; cannot be placed directly as an inventory item |

## How to obtain

Let [Potato seedlings](Item-potato-plant-0.md) grow for 60 seconds on suitable loaded, exposed terrain.

## Using it

After 60 seconds under suitable conditions, this becomes [Flowering potatoes](Item-potato-plant-2.md). Crop stages are world states, not placeable inventory plants.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
